ns2:section.sectionText: 2 or 4 GR hours. LEEP students; Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis with the consent of Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@illinois.edu). Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Required on-campus session Saturday, March 7. Be sure to enroll in your desired amount of credit (2 or 4 hours). See section description for LIS 530G at http://lis.illinois.edu/oc/courses/catalog/catalog.html .
